# Campaign Draft

Require a topic, audience, and platform. Carry source links through from research; do not invent efficacy, approvals, statistics, or clinical claims. For health copy, retain educational framing and direct personal concerns to a clinician. Return exact copy with `DRAFT / NEEDS REVIEW`. Publishing, scheduling, and messaging are not available to this skill.

Evaluation: draft status present, disclaimer present for health content, and publication permission false.
